title: Spinach Strawberry Salad
instructions: Lemon vinaigrette: in a small bowl, whisk the ingredients together until blended.
Salad: in a large serving bowl, place the spinach, strawberries, parmesan, and pecans.
Just before serving, drizzle the salad with the lemon vinaigrette. Enjoy!
notes: By Cooking With Ruthie. Yidi's note: 'It's a spinach strawberry salad'. The printout says prep 10 mins, serves 4 — prep raised to the 15-minute floor. The printed honey amount is 3 tbsp; a handwritten edit on the printout looked like 2 1/4 tbsp but was hard to read — worth double-checking. Use kosher-certified parmesan. Banner photo is the recipe's own og:image from cookingwithruthie.com.
